cover.headline: 11 stories in 5 minutes. Lula wins, Vucic concedes, Trump holds off on Iran.

stories.head: Lula wins a fourth term, Vucic concedes
body: Brazil: Lula took about 51.8% in the runoff. Reuters says Flavio Bolsonaro has not conceded and will seek to annul the vote.
Serbia: Vucic said his party lost to the Student List. Bulgaria's presidential race goes to a Nov. 1 runoff after turnout of just 22.2% at 8 p.m.
stories.sources: Sources: CBS News, Reuters, Euronews, Al Jazeera

stories.head: Trump rules out a strike as Qatar mediates
body: Trump said there would be no strike on Iran on Sunday and is weighing a deal or force. Qatari mediators were in Tehran, per Reuters.
Saudi forces say they intercepted a missile and two drones aimed at Riyadh. Two people were hurt in the south.
stories.sources: Sources: Pakistan Today, Gulf News, Al Jazeera

stories.head: West Bank lockdown and strikes on Ukraine
body: Israel will close West Bank crossings on election day Tuesday. About 2,000 to 2,670 people are displaced in Hebron, by differing counts.
Russian strikes in Dnipro killed four and hurt 22. Kyiv says its Starlink link is restored after a dispute with the US.
stories.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera, Times of Israel, Euronews

stories.head: Oil eases from a six-month high
body: Brent fell 1.6% to $114.88 after a 6.2% weekly jump. Korea's index is down almost 20% this month.
Markets price about an 80% chance of a Fed hike in December. Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon report this week.

stories.head: Midterms, abuse deal and a typhoon
body: US: Obama campaigned in Ohio and Michigan eight days before the Nov. 3 midterms.
New York's archdiocese will pay over $800m to about 1,300 abuse survivors. Typhoon Champi weakened after passing Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines.
